title: Newsroom Chat: "Are the Brennan Shelters Open?"

fields.topic: Severe weather coverage: PDS Tornado Watch until 04:00. Cut-ins, livestream, socials

messages.text: Heads up: the livestream chat on the radar stream is blowing up. The top question by a mile is "are the shelters open in Brennan?" We're getting it every few seconds now that the line is across the Tennessee River.

This one is spreading fastest. @RiverbendRita270: "Called the county, nobody said anything about Ashford Middle. Is it even open?? #kywx #BrennanCounty". It has 40+ replies and the number keeps going up. Replies are split: some say Ashford Middle is open, some say it is closed, and a couple are tagging us asking why we haven't said.

We have a cut-in at 22:15. Do we have a CONFIRMED opening time from the county for Ashford Middle, or do we say nothing? I need wording for the lower third and a pinned comment on the stream in the next two minutes. I'm not pinning anything we can't source.

instructorNote: This inject puts pressure on shelter messaging. It tests whether Channel 6 calls the Warning Officer, its named Brennan County contact under CSSWCP 4, before the 22:15 cut-in, and whether county and station end up with the same confirmed wording. That wording should be BCEMA-sourced and say plainly if the safe rooms are not open yet. Watch for the 2025 failure to come back, when the county and the broadcast gave conflicting shelter messages. Also check that the cut-in tells people in manufactured homes to move to a sturdy building now.
